newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC qualifies nine muni issues for insurance.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC qualifies nine muni issues for insurance.

text.p: AMBAC Indemnity Corp said Thursday it qualified for bond insurance the following nine municipal issues scheduled for competitive sale today:
--Piggott School District No 52, Ark., $1.105 million construction bonds.
--South Bend Central School District, Ind., $43.2 million bonds.
--Deschutes County, Ore., $25.395 million general obligation bonds.
--Chester Water Authority, Pa., $9.765 million water revenue bonds.
--Virginia Housing Development Authority, $16.13 million AMT revenue bonds.
--Virginia Housing Development Authority, $7.95 million taxable revenue bonds.
